    WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository
    WhoSpringSecurityAutoConfiguration.whoSessionSecurityContextRepository(WhoService whoService, WhoSessions whoSessions, Clock clock, WhoEventPublisher whoEventPublisher, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<StatelessLoginMethod> statelessMethods)
    Keeps only a WhoSession (ids and the sign-in time) in the HTTP session and resolves the principal again on every request, so a deactivated identity or a revoked credential takes effect at once.
